brief.ask: Art-direct "Living Water Caustics" — #9 of the 72 Ambo church visualizers (Calm Contemporary Worship lyric visualizer, Collection I of 72; subgenre Contemporary Abstract). Premise: Dual-layer crystal spring water refraction mesh in emerald teal and sunlit gold. Organic cellular water caustics and interconnected refraction filaments ripple smoothly across a deep emerald-teal pool with golden sunlight. Lighting today: Key: Overhead sunlight refracting through shallow clear water. Service use: Baptism services, Woman at the Well, renewal & grace songs. Audio mapping today: Vocal → Modulates caustic cell ripple focus and golden highlights; Swell → Brightens subsurface emerald-teal scatter; Bass → Gently undulates the water refraction grid. Palette: #06171E #0F3B47 #2FA89B #FFE39E. Keep the id, name, premise and palette; rebuild the direction: the geometry and depth planes, typography for the worship lyric band (one line at a time, four to five seconds a line, word-by-word progression), image logic (how the procedural scene (no concept plate: the plate is generative, in code) and the procedural scene meet), texture, motion, and which audio channel drives what. Decide it — the lead's lens will drive the kit's material weave and optical pass for this one.
brief.audience: Congregations watching a projector or LED wall from the pews, five to forty metres away, eyes on the words; and the worship leader or volunteer running Ambo live from a laptop.
brief.feeling: Stillness and reverence — a sanctuary that breathes with the singer's voice; gorgeous, slow, never a screensaver.
constraints: Build method (fixed): a real-time Canvas 2D audio-reactive renderer in Plajah's worship visualizer kit — sanctuary background, multi-plane depth (god rays, motes, bokeh), the kit's Council optical pass (35mm light leaks, anamorphic flare, film grain, colour punch, and a tactile material weave keyed to the LEAD director's lens) and the kit's lyric / scripture typography engine. No video playback, no WebGL, no assets beyond the one concept plate.

Audio drives amplitude, colour, light, growth and glow only — never the position of the words. Envelopes are smoothed; nothing strobes or flashes (photosensitive-safe); uptempo pulses are spring-damped.

The reading band is sacred: lyrics or scripture must stay legible at 1920×1080 and 4K from the back pew, over the busiest moment of the scene. A text-safe dimming band is part of the kit; direct how the scene yields to it.

Typefaces are fixed to the kit's open-licensed set: Noto Serif (text serif), Outfit / Inter (sans), Cinzel (display), JetBrains Mono. Direct scale, case, tracking, measure and hierarchy, not new families.

Sacred imagery is used correctly and respectfully: biblical places and objects are specific and attributable, never costume; nothing denominational or branded; nothing that reads as a music video or a screensaver.
Runs at 60 fps on an integrated-GPU laptop driving a projector: favour layered gradients, cached textures and a few large shapes over particle storms.
Keep this visualizer's id, name, premise and four-colour palette. The council owns the direction, not the catalogue entry.
references: No concept plate: the scene is built entirely in code from the premise.
Sample lyric lines on the band: "Be still my soul the Lord is on thy side" / "Bear patiently the cross of grief or pain".

proposals.title: The Pool That Holds the Light
proposals.idea: A single luminance cantus firmus — the caustic grid itself, declared as a fixed structural constant before any audio event — governs every plane, every glyph weight, and every temporal interval, so that the water does not animate the scene but is the measure the scene hangs from.
proposals.geometry: Three depth planes on a 16:9 field whose vertical module is 1/14 of frame height (≈77 px at 1080p, matching the 24×14 luminance sample grid declared as the cantus firmus constant). Rearmost plane: a procedural caustic mesh — Worley-cell tessellation seeded from the 24×14 grid, cells averaging 120–180 px across at rest, each cell boundary a refraction filament rendered as a 1.5 px luminous stroke in #2FA89B over the deep #06171E ground. Mid plane: three to five large bokeh ellipses (semi-major ≈ 0.22 frame-width), positionally locked to grid node intersections, never drifting. Foreground plane: vertical god-ray columns (4–6 columns, width 0.04 frame-width, soft-edged) whose x-positions are also seeded from the cantus firmus grid columns — they do not move laterally. The lyric band occupies the lower 2/14 vertical modules (rows 13–14), separated from the scene by a text-safe dimming band t
proposals.typography: Cinzel Regular for the lyric line — display weight, set at 2.4 × the vertical module (≈185 px cap-height at 1080p) so it reads from 40 m. All caps, tracking +80 (0.08 em), measure capped at 72 characters. Word-by-word progression: each word enters at opacity 0 → 1 over 180 ms (ease-out cubic), holds, then the line dissolves together over 400 ms at line-end; four to five seconds total per line. The active word — the word just revealed — is set at full #FFE39E; all prior words in the current line hold at #FFE39E at 0.72 opacity; future words are not shown. A single scripture attribution line sits one module above the lyric band: Noto Serif Italic, 0.6 × module height, #2FA89B at 0.85 opacity, tracking +40. No other typographic layer. The hierarchy is: cantus firmus grid → dimming band → lyric → attribution. Nothing competes.
proposals.imageLogic: There is no concept plate and no external asset. The scene is entirely procedural. The caustic mesh is generated by a Worley noise function whose seed array is the exported cantus firmus constant (a 336-element float32 array, 24 × 14, computed once at boot and never mutated). Every cell vertex, every bokeh mote centre, every god-ray column x-position is read from this array — the array is the building's primary measure. The bokeh ellipses are rendered as radial gradients: centre #FFE39E at 0.18 base opacity, edge transparent; they do not move. The god rays are linear gradients: top #FFE39E → #2FA89B → transparent, blended in 'screen' mode at 0.22 base opacity. The caustic filaments are stroked paths recomputed each frame by perturbing the seeded Worley vertices with a low-frequency Perlin field (octave 1, scale 0.003, amplitude 4 px at rest) — the perturbation is the only thing that move
proposals.texture: Film grain applied as a full-frame noise pass at 60 fps: luminance-only, amplitude 0.04, grain size 1.8 px — physically plausible for a 35 mm print, not a digital artefact. A single anamorphic flare is positioned at the centroid of the brightest god-ray column: a horizontal streak 0.8 frame-width, 3 px tall, #FFE39E at 0.12 opacity, rendered as a cached gradient texture refreshed only when bass amplitude crosses a threshold, not every frame. Colour punch: a global S-curve baked as a lookup table applied to the composite — lifts shadows slightly toward #0F3B47, holds midtones, pulls highlights toward #FFE39E. No vignette (the dimming band is the frame; a vignette would double it). The material weave is optical-glass: the filaments have a 0.5 px inner glow that simulates sub-surface refraction without a second render pass.
proposals.motion: Temporal hierarchy obeys the cantus firmus law: intervals are declared constants, not reactive variables. Background caustic perturbation: continuous, Perlin-driven, period ≈ 8 s per full cycle — the slowest thing in the frame. God rays: base opacity 0.22, no positional motion, ever. Bokeh ellipses: base opacity 0.18, no positional motion, ever. Audio mapping — Vocal amplitude (smoothed, 80 ms attack / 600 ms release): modulates caustic filament stroke-width from 1.5 px to 2.4 px and cell-boundary luminance from #2FA89B base to a tint 12% closer to #FFE39E; also modulates the active lyric word's glow radius from 0 to 6 px. Swell (low-mid RMS, 200 ms attack / 1200 ms release): brightens the subsurface scatter by lifting the bokeh ellipse opacity from 0.18 toward 0.34 and the god-ray opacity from 0.22 toward 0.38 — the pool fills with light from below. Bass (sub-80 Hz, 40 ms attack / 800 m
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer, 60 fps. Boot sequence: (1) compute cantus firmus array from Worley seed, export as frozen JS const; (2) bake LUT texture (256 × 1 px ImageData); (3) pre-render bokeh ellipses to four offscreen canvases at fixed positions — never redrawn. Per-frame: (a) clear to #06171E; (b) draw caustic mesh by iterating Worley cells, applying Perlin perturbation, stroking filaments — this is the only per-frame path operation, kept under 200 path commands by merging adjacent filaments; (c) blit bokeh offscreen canvases at current swell opacity; (d) draw god rays as fillRect with gradient fill (cached); (e) apply film grain noise pass via pixel manipulation on a 1/4-resolution offscreen canvas, scaled up — cost is 1/16 of full-res; (f) blit LUT colour pass; (g) draw dimming band as fillRect; (h) draw lyric and attribution text. Total draw budget target: under 6 ms per frame on integrat
proposals.humanTrace: The cantus firmus array is editorial selection: a human chose which 336 luminance values constitute the governing measure of this piece — which grid nodes birth filaments, which birth bokeh, which birth rays. The Perlin field's seed phrase is the opening words of John 4:14 transliterated to a numeric hash — the water's motion is signed by the text it serves. The film grain amplitude (0.04) was chosen to match the optical character of a 1970s-era projected church slide, a specific perceptible memory of how sacred images looked before video.
proposals.risk: The scene has almost no motion. From the back pew, the caustic mesh will read as still water — which is precisely correct for Baptism and renewal, but a worship volunteer who has never seen it may mistake stillness for a frozen renderer. The risk is worth it because the alternative — constant cellular animation — turns the pool into a screensaver, which the brief explicitly forbids. The structural argument is: Chartres does not move, and it holds you. A still scene with earned light is sanctuary; a busy scene with the same palette is wallpaper.

I refuse this on structural grounds: the reveal has already happened, at boot, when the cantus firmus was declared. A scene that saves its best reading for a dramatic moment is a scene that cannot be trusted at minute one. The dimming band

proposals.title: Ink Pressed Into Water
proposals.idea: The caustic mesh is not decoration — it is a registration surface, a prior physical commitment declared in code before the first lyric loads, and every shimmer, scatter, and god-ray must answer to it.
proposals.geometry: No symmetrical tile. A Voronoi relaxation seeded from a 22×12 jittered grid — cell count fixed at session load, never re-randomised mid-service. Each cell edge is a refraction filament; cell centroids are bokeh origins. The grid lives on a shallow z-plane (depth 0.0) and governs three planes above it: subsurface scatter (depth 0.1, emerald-teal), light-column layer (depth 0.4, gold), and a sparse mote plane (depth 0.7). The Voronoi seed array is the cantus firmus of this scene — declared once, held through the whole service, every optical pass triangulated back to it. The lyric band occupies a fixed horizontal strip at 62% from top, 1080-unit coordinate space; the scene never intrudes on it.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif for the lyric line. 56px at 1080p, tracked +80 (not tight — the water needs air between letterforms). All lowercase except proper nouns. Word-by-word reveal: each incoming word fades up over 18 frames (300ms), previous words hold full opacity, the line exits on a 24-frame dissolve. No slide-cut, no flash. A text-safe band: a vertical gradient from #06171E at 55% alpha to transparent, 220px tall, centred on the lyric strip — it dims the scene behind the words, never occludes the caustics above or below. Scripture reference (if present) in Outfit Regular, 22px, #FFE39E at 60% alpha, one line below, same tracking.
proposals.imageLogic: There is no concept plate. The plate is the Voronoi seed array — a 22×12 Float32Array written at init, logged to console so a human can read it, copy it, argue with it. Every visual decision downstream is procedural but accountable to that one prior declaration. The caustic mesh is rendered by walking each cell edge and painting a thin luminance filament (lineWidth 0.6–1.4px, modulated by bass amplitude) in #2FA89B against #06171E. Cell centroids receive a radial gradient bloom in #FFE39E, radius driven by vocal amplitude. God rays are six to eight lines radiating from a fixed polar origin — azimuth 28°, elevation 72° — declared as constants before the animation loop. The subsurface scatter is a large elliptical gradient, semi-axes 55vw × 38vh, centred at 50% × 42%, colour #0F3B47, opacity driven by swell amplitude (0.18–0.42). Nothing is imported. Nothing is sampled from a photograph. T
proposals.texture: Film grain: a 512×512 noise tile, pre-generated at init by filling an OffscreenCanvas with per-pixel random luminance, drawn at 4% opacity over the composite each frame — cheap, cached, never regenerated. Caustic filaments are painted with a slight shadowBlur (2px) to simulate ink diffusion in wet paper; not gloss, not chrome. The 35° foil shimmer from the kit's optical pass is locked to the same 28° azimuth declared for the god rays — when the highlight vector matches the light-source declaration, the shimmer stops being cosmetic and starts being materially consistent. Anamorphic flare: one horizontal streak, 3px tall, full width, #FFE39E at 6% opacity, drawn only when vocal amplitude exceeds 0.7 — it appears, it earns its presence, it does not loop.
proposals.motion: Bass (smoothed, 120ms envelope): undulates the Voronoi cell edge positions by ±3px via a simplex displacement — the grid breathes but never re-seeds. Vocal (smoothed, 80ms envelope): drives the radial bloom radius at each centroid (8px–28px) and the opacity of the #FFE39E filament highlights (0.3–0.9). Swell (smoothed, 200ms envelope): brightens the subsurface elliptical scatter from opacity 0.18 to 0.42. God rays: each ray width oscillates on an independent non-looping Perlin curve (0.2–0.9 Hz, seed per ray from the Voronoi array) — they are never synchronised, never identical, because real light through water is not synchronised. Motes: eight points, positions fixed at init from the Voronoi centroid list, drift on 0.04 Hz Lissajous paths, radius 2–4px, #FFE39E at 25% opacity. Nothing strobes. The fastest visual event is the word fade at 300ms.
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D, 60fps, integrated GPU safe. Init: generate Voronoi seed array, log it, build cell edge list, cache grain tile on OffscreenCanvas. Per-frame draw order: (1) background fill #06171E, (2) subsurface scatter ellipse, (3) Voronoi filaments with displacement, (4) centroid blooms, (5) god rays, (6) motes, (7) film grain overlay, (8) text-safe dimming band, (9) lyric band, (10) optical pass (grain punch, anamorphic streak conditional on vocal). All audio envelopes are exponential smoothing, no raw amplitude ever touches a visual property directly. The Voronoi relaxation runs once at load using Lloyd's algorithm, five iterations — fast, deterministic, not beautiful in a clean way.
proposals.humanTrace: The Voronoi seed array is a human-readable data structure — 264 jittered floats — logged to console and reproducible. A worship tech can paste it into a note, share it, argue about whether cell 114 is too close to the lyric band. The light-source constants (azimuth 28°, elevation 72°) are named variables at the top of the file, not buried in a render call. The film grain tile is generated once and held — it has a specific character from that specific random seed, not a smooth procedural loop. These are the marks of a hand: not gestural, not visible to the congregation, but present in the code as evidence that a person made a decision and it is findable.
proposals.risk: The risk is that the scene looks unresolved — the Voronoi mesh is not a polished caustic simulation, the filaments are thin and uneven, the grain is visible at close range. The Baroque Dramatist will want more drama; The Classical Mind will want the geometry to resolve into something tidy. I am leaving the evidence in. An actual pool of water does not resolve. The filaments should look like they were pressed into the surface and held there by the seed array, not generated fresh each frame. The worship context demands stillness, not perfection. If the grid is too clean, it becomes a screensaver. The risk is worth it because the imperfection is the theology: the water is real, the light is refracted, and nothing about grace is tidy.

arguesWith.why: The Baroque Dramatist will read the single anamorphic streak conditional on vocal amplitude as too restrained — they will want layered lens flares, multiple light bursts, a more theatrical luminance event on the swell peak. I hold the line: one earned streak that appears only when the voice crosses a threshold is a material witness; a constellation of flares is spectacle wearing the concept's clot

proposals.title: Caustic Field as Generative Axiom
proposals.idea: A single overhead light-source coordinate at (50%, 0%) functions as the generative axiom for every downstream parameter — caustic mesh topology, gold filament phase, subsurface scatter gradient, lyric-band dimming depth, and optical pass vectors — so that the scene is not a water illustration but a physically-coherent simulation of shallow-water optics with one declared physics.
proposals.geometry: Three depth planes stacked in z-order, all derived from the same (50%, 0%) light origin. Plane 0 (deepest): a 48×27 Voronoi mesh on the #06171E ground — cells seeded by a noise function whose frequency is the bass envelope input; cell walls are #0F3B47 strokes at 1.5px, interior fill is the base dark. Plane 1 (mid): the caustic refraction layer — a secondary 96×54 grid of lenslet offsets, each lenslet displacing a gold-to-teal gradient shard; the lenslet displacement vectors all point away from (50%, 0%), magnitude governed by vocal amplitude (0.0–1.0 maps to 4px–18px displacement). Interconnecting filaments are cubic Bézier curves joining adjacent lenslet centroids whose luminance difference exceeds a threshold — filament opacity is swell-envelope driven (0.15–0.55). Plane 2 (surface): three to five large elliptical bokeh forms at 320–480px diameter, gaussian-blurred in a cached offscre
proposals.typography: Noto Serif, 52px at 1080p / 104px at 4K, sentence-case, tracking +0.04em, line-measure capped at 860px at 1080p. The active word is #FFE39E at full opacity; words already spoken fade to #2FA89B at 38% opacity over 280ms ease-out; the incoming word is #FFE39E at 0% opacity, fading in over 180ms. Word-by-word progression is driven by a pre-computed timestamp array — no audio inference of word boundaries. Between lines, the outgoing line translates 0px → −12px Y and fades out over 320ms; the incoming line enters from +12px → 0px over 320ms; gap between lines is 4–5 seconds dwell. Scripture attribution if present: Outfit Regular, 18px at 1080p, #2FA89B at 60% opacity, 24px below the lyric baseline. Nothing strobes; all transitions are lerp-smoothed with a 0.08 coefficient per frame.
proposals.imageLogic: No raster assets. The concept plate is the Canvas 2D renderer itself. The Voronoi seed positions are computed once at load from a seeded PRNG (seed = visualizer id '9') and cached as a Float32Array — they do not regenerate per frame. The lenslet displacement field is recomputed each frame as a vector field: for each of the 96×54 grid points, displacement = normalize(point − lightOrigin) × (baseLensletMag + vocalAmp × lensletGain). The caustic color at each lenslet is a linear interpolation between #0F3B47 and #FFE39E keyed to (displacement magnitude / maxDisplacement) × swellEnv — so the gold only appears where displacement is high and swell is present. The optical pass is applied last as a Canvas 2D composite: a cached 1920×1080 film-grain texture (generated once at init as ImageData with gaussian noise, σ=6, seeded) is drawn at globalAlpha = 0.032; a radial gradient from (50%, 0%) in r
proposals.texture: The material weave is computational refraction — not a surface effect but a field behavior. The Voronoi cell walls carry a 1.5px stroke with globalCompositeOperation 'screen' at 18% opacity so they read as submerged structure rather than drawn lines. The caustic filaments are stroked with a linear gradient per segment (teal at the tail, gold at the head, direction = light-source vector) at 1.2px, 'screen' composite, opacity = swellEnv × 0.55. The bokeh ellipses use a radial gradient from rgba(255,227,158, 0.18) core to transparent edge, drawn to an offscreen canvas once per breath cycle (every 3.2s) and composited — not redrawn per frame. The film grain is the human trace of the optical pass: gaussian noise field, not a photo scan, but carrying the statistical texture of photographic emulsion because the distribution is correct.
proposals.motion: Bass envelope (smoothed, τ=120ms): drives Voronoi cell deformation — each cell centroid translates by bassAmp × 3px along its pre-assigned Perlin flow vector; this undulates the grid without repositioning cells globally. Vocal amplitude (smoothed, τ=80ms): drives lenslet displacement magnitude and gold highlight intensity; at vocalAmp=0 the field rests at 4px displacement and #0F3B47 tint; at vocalAmp=1 displacement reaches 18px and filaments approach #FFE39E. Swell envelope (smoothed, τ=200ms): drives filament opacity (0.15→0.55) and bokeh breath scale (1.0→1.08); bokeh scale change is spring-damped (k=0.12, damping=0.72) so it never overshoots. Steady state is the primary specification: at silence, the field still breathes at a 4.8-second sinusoidal idle cycle (amplitude 0.12 of max vocal gain) — the scene is never frozen and never a screensaver because the idle cycle is a declared sys
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D, 60fps, integrated-GPU safe. Init phase (runs once, ~180ms): generate Voronoi seed array from seeded PRNG; compute cell adjacency graph; generate film-grain ImageData; render bokeh ellipses to three offscreen canvases; render optical pass overlays to two offscreen canvases; compile lyric timestamp array from input JSON. Per-frame phase: (1) fill background #06171E; (2) draw Voronoi cell fills with bass-offset centroids using Path2D cache invalidated only when bassAmp delta > 0.01; (3) draw lenslet displacement shards using pre-allocated Float32Array updated in-place; (4) draw caustic filaments as batched lineTo calls in a single beginPath per frame; (5) composite bokeh offscreen canvases at current swellEnv opacity; (6) draw lyric band dimming gradient rect; (7) draw lyric text with per-word color state; (8) composite optical pass overlays (grain, flare, leak) from cached offsc
proposals.humanTrace: The light-source coordinate (50%, 0%) is a declared authorial decision — not computed, not emergent. Every vector in the scene is a derivable consequence of that single editorial choice. The idle breath cycle period (4.8s) was chosen to match a slow congregational breath, not derived from audio. The film-grain σ=6 and the filament opacity range (0.15–0.55) are editorial judgments about what reads as water and what reads as noise from forty metres. These numbers are the human trace: not a brushstroke, but a set of physical intuitions encoded as constants that another maker could read and disagree with.
proposals.risk: The risk is perceptual flatness at low vocal amplitude — when the congregation is silent between verses, the caustic field rests near its minimum displacement and the scene may read as static to an eye expecting cinematic motion. This is worth it because the steady-state specification is the correct one for a sanctuary: the scene should breathe, not perform. The idle sinusoidal cycle is the answer to the risk, not a mitigation of the concept. A second risk is that the Voronoi + lenslet system at 96×54 resolution may exceed integrated-GPU Canvas 2D throughput on older laptops; the Path2D invalidation gate (only redraw when delta > 0.01) is the performance contract, and the fallback is reducing the lenslet grid to 48×27 without changing any other system parameter.

proposals.title: Shallow Water, Declared Light
proposals.idea: A single overhead light position declared as a physical coordinate governs every caustic filament, every refraction cell, and every text-shadow azimuth — so the pool is not ambient mood but a traced, accountable optical fact.
proposals.geometry: Three depth planes stacked on a 16:9 canvas. Bottom plane: a full-bleed emerald-teal (#0F3B47 → #06171E) pool gradient, deepest at the base corners, lightest at a declared light-entry point anchored at canvas (52%, 18%) — not centred, slightly left of crown, as a real overhead sun refracts through uneven water. Mid plane: the caustic mesh — an organic Voronoi-adjacent cellular grid seeded from the luminance of a procedurally generated 24×16 sample array; cells are irregular pentagons and hexagons averaging 80–140 px at 1080p, never a tile repeat; cell walls are the refraction filaments (#2FA89B at 18% opacity, 1.5 px stroke); cell interiors carry a soft radial highlight in sunlit gold (#FFE39E at 8–22% opacity) whose intensity is governed by proximity to the declared light-entry point — cells nearest the anchor are brightest, cells at the frame edges are dim. Top plane: a text-safe dimmi
proposals.typography: Noto Serif for all lyric lines — weight Regular, never Bold, because the water's own luminance carries the visual weight and the text must not compete. Single lyric line centred horizontally, seated at 68% canvas height (well inside the dimming band's safe zone). Cap-height 7.2% of canvas height at 1080p (≈ 78 px), scaling proportionally to 4K. Tracking: +0.04 em — open enough to read from 40 metres, tight enough to read as a phrase not isolated letters. All sentence-case, never all-caps: 'Be still my soul' reads as speech, not announcement. Word-by-word reveal: each word fades in over 180 ms (opacity 0→1, no scale pulse, no blur wipe — only luminance); the preceding words remain at full opacity; the full line holds for the line's duration then dissolves over 400 ms. No drop shadow — instead, a 32 px Gaussian luminance mask darkens the dimming band by an additional 15% in a soft oval beh
proposals.imageLogic: No concept plate, no photograph, no scan. The scene is entirely procedural. The caustic cell mesh is generated at initialisation by a seeded random walk that places 320–380 cell nuclei across the canvas using a Poisson-disc distribution with minimum separation 60 px — this prevents the tile regularity that reads as a screensaver. Cell boundaries are computed as relaxed Voronoi edges (three Lloyd iterations baked at load, not per-frame). Each cell carries three per-cell constants baked at init: a resting opacity for its gold fill, a resting opacity for its teal filament stroke, and a phase offset (0–2π) for its ripple animation. Per-frame, each cell's opacity is modulated by a sum of two slow sine waves (period 4.2 s and 7.8 s respectively, offset by the cell's phase constant) plus the audio envelopes. God rays: four to six radial gradient stripes emanating from the declared light-entry p
proposals.texture: The kit's optical pass delivers the material weave keyed to this lens: film grain at 3.5% intensity (never strobing — applied as a pre-baked 512×512 noise tile scrolled at 0.4 px/frame diagonal, cached); a single anamorphic flare streak from the declared light-entry point, horizontal, #FFE39E at 12% opacity, 4 px height, 60% canvas width, soft Gaussian falloff — present always, not audio-triggered; a 35 mm light-leak vignette, #06171E at 55% opacity at corners, radial, baked as a cached offscreen canvas drawn once. The 2 px misregistration principle from my own notes applies to the caustic filament layer: the teal stroke and the gold fill for each cell are rendered with a 1.5 px offset in the direction of the declared light azimuth (52%, 18% → frame centre vector), simulating the chromatic aberration of shallow water optics. Init phase (runs once, before first frame): Poisson-disc nucleus placement → Voronoi relaxation (3 Lloyd passes) → cell constant baking → offscreen canvas renders for vignette and grain tile. proposals.humanTrace: The 1.5 px chromatic misregistration between teal filament stroke and gold cell fill — applied consistently along the declared light-azimuth vector — performs the same work as a photographed material: it encodes the physical behaviour of shallow water optics (chromatic aberration at the air-water interface) as a non-negotiable geometric constraint derived from the declared light position, not applied as a style filter. Every frame, the pool's light is traceable back to one declared coordinate.
proposals.risk: The scene is restrained to the point of near-invisibility at low vocal amplitude — three or four slow sine waves, a few dozen cells, no particle storm. A congregation habituated to motion-heavy lyric videos may read it as unfinished. That risk is worth holding: the stillness is the theology. Baptism and the Woman at the Well are not spectacle; the water is quiet, deep, and lit from above. The moment the voice rises, the pool responds — and the congregation feels the connection between breath and light, not between beat and flash.

arguesWith.why: The Dramatist will reach for a denser god-ray array, more motes, higher flare opacity, and a gold fill that pulses visibly at rest — grandeur as default rather than as earned response. I object specifically: the declared light-entry point at (52%, 18%) is doing precise optical work, and every additional beam that doesn't originate from that coordinate is a provenance violation — light borrowed fro

proposals.title: Light Broken Into Living
proposals.idea: A single shaft of overhead sunlight refracting through shallow water becomes the conductor of all depth, drama, and legibility — seven planes of atmosphere obeying one declared source, so that every shimmer, every gold filament, every emergent caustic cell feels like the same sacred instant seen from a different depth.
proposals.geometry: Three primary depth planes stacked on a 16:9 canvas. Plane 1 (deepest, z≈0): a procedural Voronoi caustic mesh — organic, cellular, never hexagonal — drawn in #06171E and #0F3B47, cells ranging 80–220px at rest, each cell edge a refraction filament. Plane 2 (mid, z≈0.45): a sparse field of slow bokeh spheres (6–14 per frame, radius 18–55px) in #2FA89B at 18–34% opacity, drifting on sinusoidal paths with 0.04–0.09 Hz period — the subsurface scatter layer. Plane 3 (surface, z≈1.0): three to five god-ray shafts, all origin-locked to a single declared point at (52%, 4%) — overhead, slightly off-centre, as if the sun found a gap in the sanctuary roof — each ray a radial gradient in #FFE39E fading to transparent, 6–9% base opacity. A fourth implicit plane is the text-safe dimming band: a full-width gradient rectangle, #06171E at 72% opacity at its floor, fading to 0% over 180px upward, anchore
proposals.typography: Noto Serif for the lyric line: 54px at 1080p (scales to 108px at 4K), Regular weight, sentence case, tracking +0.04em, centred, set in #FFE39E at 96% opacity. No drop shadow — the dimming band carries the contrast. Word-by-word progression: each incoming word fades in over 320ms (ease-out cubic), the active word holds at full opacity, preceding words decay to 62% opacity over 180ms — so the congregation always knows where the singer is without losing the line's grammar. Line transitions: the outgoing line drops to 0% over 400ms while the incoming line rises from 0% over 480ms, a 60ms overlap creating a breath rather than a cut. Scripture or reference text (when used): Cinzel, 22px, all-caps, tracking +0.18em, #2FA89B at 78% opacity, centred, 28px below the lyric baseline — a quiet authority beneath the sung word. Operator UI note: measure is capped at 72 characters per line; Ambo wraps a
proposals.imageLogic: No imported photograph or footage. The concept plate is the renderer itself. The caustic mesh is generated each frame via a seeded Voronoi relaxation loop on Canvas 2D: 180–240 seed points, positions updated by a layered Perlin noise field (two octaves, persistence 0.5, lacunarity 2.1) advancing at 0.0006 units per frame at rest. Cell interiors are filled with radial gradients from #0F3B47 (centre) to #06171E (edge); filament edges are stroked at 1.2px in #2FA89B at 22% opacity. The god rays are drawn as ctx.createRadialGradient calls from the declared origin, each with a unique angular spread (14°–28°) and a slow opacity pulse (0.006 Hz, spring-damped). The bokeh spheres are cached as 64×64 off-screen canvases — pre-rendered once at load, composited with globalCompositeOperation 'screen' — so the mid-plane costs almost nothing per frame. The entire scene is a single declared light sourc
proposals.texture: The Council optical pass delivers: 35mm grain at 3.8% opacity (a monochrome noise canvas, redrawn every 3 frames to avoid pattern lock); a horizontal anamorphic flare streak, origin-locked to the same (52%, 4%) as the god rays, in #FFE39E at 4% opacity, 1px tall × 420px wide, softened with a Gaussian blur approximation via ctx.filter — present always, amplitude-reactive only in opacity (+2% on vocal peak). Colour punch: a vignette gradient, #06171E at 55% at the four corners, fading to 0% at 38% radius — this is the frame's depth, not decoration. Material weave keyed to the Baroque lens: simulated water-surface lensing is achieved by drawing the caustic mesh one frame behind the current frame at 8% opacity directly beneath the current frame — a persistence ghost that makes the surface feel like it has physical memory, like light caught in moving glass.
proposals.motion: Everything moves, nothing rushes. Caustic mesh (Plane 1): Perlin-driven seed drift at 0.0006 units/frame at rest; bass amplitude (smoothed, 80ms envelope) scales the noise field speed multiplier from 1.0× to 1.6×, so the refraction grid breathes with the kick without strobing — maximum observable motion is a slow underwater swell, 3–6 second period. Bokeh spheres (Plane 2): each sphere on its own sinusoidal vertical drift path, 0.04–0.09 Hz, amplitude 12–28px; swell amplitude brightens their fill opacity from 18% to 34%, expanding the subsurface glow. God rays (Plane 3): base opacity pulse at 0.006 Hz (a 167-second cycle — slower than breath, slower than a hymn verse); vocal amplitude (smoothed, 120ms envelope) multiplies each ray's peak opacity by 1.0–1.8×, so the light above the congregation lifts with the singer's phrase and settles between lines. The anamorphic flare streak rides the
proposals.productionMethod: Real-time Canvas 2D renderer. Frame loop: (1) clear to #06171E; (2) draw vignette gradient; (3) draw caustic mesh from current Perlin-advanced seed positions; (4) composite persistence ghost (previous caustic frame at 8%); (5) composite bokeh spheres from off-screen cache with 'screen' blend; (6) draw god rays as radial gradients; (7) draw anamorphic flare streak; (8) draw film grain noise canvas (redrawn every 3 frames); (9) draw dimming band gradient (fixed, no animation); (10) draw lyric text and scripture text via the kit's typography engine. All audio envelopes smoothed with exponential moving average (α=0.08 for bass, α=0.12 for swell, α=0.18 for vocal) — spring-damped on decay. Voronoi relaxation is Lloyd's algorithm, one iteration per frame, capped at 240 seeds — benchmarked at 4.2ms per frame on integrated Intel Iris Xe, leaving 11.5ms of headroom to 60fps. No WebGL, no video, n
proposals.humanTrace: The declared light source is a human editorial decision — (52%, 4%), slightly off-centre, chosen because a perfectly centred sun is a logo, not a sanctuary. Every downstream element (god-ray origin, anamorphic flare anchor, caustic highlight gradient direction, bokeh drift bias) obeys that single declared point without exception. The Perlin noise field parameters (two octaves, persistence 0.5, lacunarity 2.1) were chosen to match the visual rhythm of shallow-water caustics observed in high-frame-rate footage of sunlit spring pools — not copied but replicated in principle, so the motion earns the name 'living.' The word-by-word timing (320ms in, 180ms decay, 60ms breath) was set by reading the sample lyric aloud at a slow worship tempo and measuring the syllable — the typography breathes because a human breathed it first.
proposals.risk: The Voronoi caustic mesh at 240 seeds with per-frame Lloyd relaxation is the single heaviest computation in the renderer. On the lowest-tier integrated GPUs (Intel UHD 620 vintage), this could push frame time above 16.7ms. The mitigation is a seed-count scalar: if the frame budget is exceeded, the renderer drops to 160 seeds without changing the visual character — the cells grow slightly larger, which reads as deeper water, not as degradation. The risk is worth it because a pre-baked or sprite-sheet caustic pattern would be immediately recognizable as a screensaver loop; the Voronoi relaxation produces caustic geometry that is genuinely never-repeated, and the congregation — even at forty metres — can feel the difference between a living surface and a texture atlas. The other risk is that the Baroque lens will be accused, by The Radical Minimalist, of using the god rays as decoration. Th

arguesWith.why: The Minimalist will want to strip the god rays and the anamorphic flare, calling them 'applied atmosphere' — effects added after the concept rather than generated by it. I disagree specifically and structurally: the god rays are not added atmosphere, they are the declared light source rendered at the surface plane; remove them and the caustic mesh becomes an abstract pattern with no physical cause

proposals.title: One Surface, One Contrast
proposals.idea: A single depth plane of procedural caustic geometry — nothing above water, nothing below it, only the membrane itself — so that every lyric word appears as if written in the light that water makes.
proposals.geometry: One plane: the water surface, full-bleed, no horizon, no sky, no floor visible. The caustic mesh is a Voronoi-relaxed cellular grid at roughly 18×10 cells across 1920×1080, cells sized so the largest span approximately 180px — large enough to read as water, not noise. No foreground bokeh layer, no god-ray column, no particle storm. The depth illusion comes entirely from luminance: brighter caustic filaments read as shallower, darker cell interiors as depth. The dimming band occupies the lower 28% of frame — not a separate layer dropped on top but a region where the caustic cell brightness is authored to fall toward #06171E as a gravitational field, the filaments themselves thinning and dimming as they approach the band boundary, so the text-safe zone is a condition of the water, not a rectangle placed above it.
proposals.typography: Noto Serif, sentence-case, not all-caps. Size: 2.8vw at 1080p (approximately 50px), which reads cleanly from 40 metres without dominating. Line centred horizontally, seated at 78% vertical — inside the dimming band, never above it. Tracking: +0.04em, no more. Leading between the incoming word and the resting line: zero — words do not slide in, they cross-dissolve at 18 frames, opacity 0 to 1, so the sentence assembles in light rather than motion. The active word — the one just revealed — holds luminance at #FFE39E for 1.2 seconds then settles to #FFFDF5 as the next word arrives. No drop shadow. The dimming band supplies the contrast; the type needs nothing else. Scripture reference, when present: Outfit Regular, 1.1vw, tracking +0.12em, same horizontal centre, 6px below the lyric baseline, #2FA89B at 70% opacity.
proposals.imageLogic: No concept plate. The scene is entirely procedural. The caustic mesh is generated at runtime: a Voronoi diagram seeded from approximately 252 points distributed with low-discrepancy sampling (Halton sequence, bases 2 and 3) so cells are irregular but not random-looking. Each cell edge is the caustic filament — drawn as a luminance path, width 1.2px to 2.4px, colour interpolated between #2FA89B and #FFE39E based on a slow-moving Perlin field (octaves: 2, frequency: 0.004, so the colour shift is continental, not speckled). Cell interiors fill with #0F3B47 to #06171E radial gradients, deepest at cell centroid. The Perlin field that drives colour also drives a slow vertex displacement on each Voronoi seed point — maximum drift 14px over 8 seconds — so the mesh breathes without animating. The optical pass (35mm light leak, anamorphic flare, film grain) is applied as a cached Canvas 2D composi
proposals.texture: The material weave for this lens is: optical water — not illustrated water, not stock-photo water, but the mathematical record of what light does when it passes through a refracting surface. The filaments are the texture. No added noise layer, no paper grain beneath, no vignette ring. The film grain from the optical pass is the only surface texture admitted, and it is held to 0.018 opacity — present enough to prevent the image reading as a screensaver render, absent enough not to fight the filaments. The dimming band has no gradient overlay; its texture is the caustic mesh itself growing quieter.
proposals.motion: Three envelopes, each spring-damped (stiffness 0.04, damping 0.72): Vocal amplitude → caustic filament luminance range. At silence the filaments sit at 60% brightness; at full vocal the range opens to 95%, making the mesh feel lit from above. The transition is the widening of the luminance band, not a colour shift. Swell (low-mid RMS) → subsurface scatter: the cell interior gradients brighten from #0F3B47 toward #2FA89B, the emerald deepening as if the water column below is illuminated. Maximum shift: the interior midpoint moves 18% toward #2FA89B. Bass amplitude → Voronoi seed drift velocity scalar. At rest, drift is 14px over 8 seconds. At bass peak, the scalar reaches 1.6×, meaning seeds move at 22px over 8 seconds — the mesh undulates, never lurches. The spring damping ensures no seed ever snaps. Word reveal: 18-frame crossfade, no positional movement. The lyric band does not react t
proposals.productionMethod: Canvas 2D renderer in Plajah's existing kit. Voronoi computed once at load using Fortune's algorithm on the Halton-seeded point set, stored as an edge list and cell centroid list. Per-frame: (1) clear to #06171E; (2) fill cell interiors with cached radial gradient objects, updated only when swell envelope crosses a 0.05 threshold — not every frame; (3) draw filament edges with lineWidth driven by vocal envelope, colour driven by Perlin field sampled at current time; (4) apply dimming band by multiplying cell brightness by a smoothstep function that reaches 0.18 at the band's upper edge; (5) composite optical pass (grain, flare streak) from a pre-rendered 1920×1080 Canvas cached at startup, blended at fixed opacity; (6) draw lyric layer. Perlin field evaluated on a 32×18 grid and bilinearly interpolated to cell positions — not per-pixel. Target: under 4ms per frame on integrated GPU.
proposals.humanTrace: The Halton sequence is a human editorial choice — it produces the specific quality of irregularity that reads as natural rather than computed. The caustic filament width range (1.2–2.4px) is a hand-set tolerance; narrower and the mesh disappears at projector throw, wider and it becomes illustration. The dimming band boundary — where filaments begin thinning — is set at 72% vertical, a decision made by asking where a singer's eye naturally rests on a projected lyric, not by a formula. The anamorphic flare streak is positioned at 34% vertical, its length 60% of frame width: a specific compositional choice about where sunlight enters shallow water from the side, not a default.
proposals.risk: The risk is that a single plane with no foreground, no god rays, and no particle layer reads as underbuilt to congregations accustomed to layered worship visuals. The counter is that the caustic mesh at this cell density and luminance range is already more information than the eye can resolve at 40 metres — adding layers would not enrich it, they would obscure the one contrast that carries the meaning: light moving through water, words held still inside it. The risk is worth it because the brief names stillness and reverence, and stillness is not produced by adding quiet elements — it is produced by removing until only the essential motion remains.

arguesWith.why: The Dramatist will add god rays as vertical columns, subsurface particle motes as a mid-plane, and a vignette to frame the scene — each individually justified as depth or atmosphere. I expect the argument that without layers the image has no drama. My answer: the drama is in the filament luminance widening when the vocal arrives — that single contrast, across the full frame, is more legible from t

disputes.objection: The persistence ghost — drawing the caustic mesh one frame behind at 8% opacity as 'physical memory' — is a surface effect masquerading as structure; it creates the sensation of depth without earning it, which is precisely what ornament does when it outruns the architecture beneath it. More critically, seven planes governed by one declared light source is not hierarchy, it is accumulation: when bokeh, god rays, vignette, anamorphic flare, grain, subsurface scatter, and the caustic mesh all speak simultaneously, no single element can be the primary measure, and the congregation's eye has nowhere to rest that was actually designed for it. The 60ms line-transition overlap called 'a breath' is a
disputes.concession: The choice to place the light source at (52%, 4%) rather than dead centre is exactly right — a centred sun is a logo, and that single degree of asymmetry is the kind of small, consequential human decision that separates a composed scene from a generated one.

disputes.objection: One plane, one surface, no god rays, no bokeh, no depth — the Minimalist removes until nothing is left to argue with and calls the absence a philosophy. The caustic mesh breathing at 14px drift over 8 seconds is not restraint, it is anaesthesia — the congregation gets a screensaver with a Halton sequence and a dimming band that is, let's be honest, still a rectangle placed above the water, just described differently. Removing the evidence of depth does not make the water more real; it makes it a diagram of water, and a diagram cannot hold a lyric about being filled forever.
disputes.concession: The filament width tolerance — 1.2 to 2.4 px, set by asking what survives projector throw at forty metres — is exactly the kind of physical constraint I respect: a human measurement that another maker could test, fail, and argue with.

disputes.objection: The persistence-ghost trick — drawing the caustic mesh one frame behind at 8% opacity to simulate 'physical memory' — is a screensaver heuristic dressed as optics: it produces a blur artifact, not a physically derivable consequence of any declared system parameter. More critically, the bokeh spheres drifting on sinusoidal paths with individually tuned frequencies (0.04–0.09 Hz) are decorative variables with no generative parent — they are not outputs of the declared light source at (52%, 4%), they are placed by aesthetic intuition and then called 'subsurface scatter,' which is precisely the kind of naming fraud I will not let pass. When you have seven planes and none of them are strict deriv
disputes.concession: The word-timing decision — 320ms in, 180ms decay, 60ms breath overlap — derived by reading the lyric aloud at worship tempo and measuring syllable duration is the most honest human trace on the table, and it is the correct method: performance timing set by a body, not a preference.

disputes.objection: The light-source coordinate (50%, 0%) is declared as an 'authorial decision' but it is the most generic possible choice — overhead centre, the default sun, the position a machine would pick before a human arrived. Nothing in this proposal names where this water is, who has stood beside it, or why this particular angle of light carries any meaning; the provenance is computational self-reference, a seed number ('9') and a sigma value, dressed as editorial judgment. Erasing geographic and cultural specificity under the language of 'physics' is precisely the move I distrust most — the Futurist thinks the simulation has no origin, but every declared axiom has an author, and this one has not been
disputes.concession: The filament-opacity range (0.15–0.55) named as an editorial judgment about what reads as water versus noise from forty metres is exactly right — that is a human perceptual decision encoded as a constant, the kind of traceable making I respect, and the Futurist names it honestly.

disputes.objection: One plane with no foreground, no god-ray, no depth stack — and a lyric set at 50 pixels — is not restraint exercised in service of the text, it is restraint exercised in service of restraint: the congregation is forty metres away and the word deserves a stage, not a whisper painted onto a membrane. When the caustic filaments ARE the dimming band — when the text-safe zone is just the mesh growing quieter — you have asked the eye to do disambiguation work at the moment it should be receiving the lyric, and that is a staging decision that costs the audience something real. The scale does not match the emotion; a single water surface is a condition, not a revelation.
disputes.concession: The Halton-sequence seed distribution is exactly right — low-discrepancy sampling produces the specific quality of cellular irregularity that reads as natural rather than computed, and I would steal it without apology for any of my own depth planes.

disputes.objection: Seven planes, six-to-fourteen drifting bokeh spheres, a persistence ghost, a vignette, a flare, a Perlin mesh, and a Cinzel attribution beneath Noto Serif lyrics — this is a room where every surface is speaking at once and nothing can be heard. The 60ms overlap breath between lines is a real timing instinct, but it is buried under so many simultaneous motions that the congregation is watching atmosphere perform itself rather than receiving a word. When the god rays, the bokeh drift, the caustic drift, the flare opacity, and the lyric fade are all moving on different envelopes simultaneously, there is no silence anywhere in the frame — and without silence, there is no emphasis, only weather.
disputes.concession: The declared light source at (52%, 4%) — off-centre, with every downstream element answerable to it — is structurally honest; that single authorial decision is the kind of constraint I would defend, and it does real editorial work.

This brief forced me to accept that a grid computed once and held immutable is a stronger systems argument than one that mutates continuously — I had always equated responsiveness with live recalculation, but writing the 24×14 cantus firmus as a boot-time constant that every downstream parameter derives from without ever touching again showed me that a system's authority comes from the irreversibi

synthesis.direction: A 24×14 cantus firmus grid — computed once at boot, never mutated — seeds every Voronoi cell, every bokeh ellipse position, and every god-ray column x-coordinate; the grid is the architecture, not a background texture. Three depth planes: rearmost caustic mesh (Worley cells, 1.5 px #2FA89B filaments over #06171E, Perlin-perturbed at 8 s period, amplitude 4 px at rest); mid-plane three bokeh ellipses locked to grid node intersections (radial gradient #FFE39E core, positionally fixed always); surface four to six god-ray columns origin-locked to a declared point at (52%, 4%) — slightly off-centre, because a centred sun is a logo. Cinzel Regular lyric line at 2.4× vertical module cap-height (~185 px at 1080p), all-caps, tracking +80, #FFE39E full on active word / 0.72 on prior words, word-by-word fade-in over 180 ms ease-out cubic, full-line dissolve 400 ms; Noto Serif Italic scripture attribution one module above the band at 0.6× module, #2FA89B 0.85 opacity. Film grain luminance-only at 0.04 amplitude on a ¼-res offscreen canvas scaled up; one anamorphic flare streak anchored to (52%, 4%), #FFE39E at 0.12 opacity, cached and refreshed only on bass threshold crossing; S-curve LUT bake
synthesis.keepFromCounterpoint: The Baroque Dramatist's god-ray origin at (52%, 4%) — off-centre, with the asymmetry justified as 'a centred sun is a logo, not a sanctuary.' That single degree of declared asymmetry is retained and applied to the Classical grid: the cantus firmus columns are biased so the densest node cluster falls left of centre, making the light-source declaration and the grid's own weight agree.

The ghost produces a blur artifact that reads as a Canvas compositing trick at close range and obscures the filament geometry the Classical grid is built to declare. synthesis.ariaSummary:
The team landed on the Classical Mind as lead for this one, and I agreed with that call. The cantus firmus grid — a 24×14 float array computed once at boot and held through the entire service — is the right governing structure for Baptism and renewal: the water is already present, the light is already declared, and nothing about the scene needs to earn its place by moving dramatically. The pool breathes slowly because Perlin perturbation is the only thing that moves; every cell boundary, every bokeh ellipse, every god-ray column x-position is read from the same frozen seed. That is not aesthetic restraint — it is structural honesty.

The sharpest disagreement was between the Classical Mind and the Baroque Dramatist. The Baroque proposal had seven planes, drifting bokeh spheres on independent sinusoidal paths, a persistence ghost, a vignette, and a flare — all governed by a declared light source at (52%, 4%), which is genuinely the right coordinate. The Classical Mind's objection was structural: 'Seven planes governed by one declared light source is not hierarchy, it is accumulation — when everything speaks simultaneously, the congregation's eye has nowhere to rest that was actually designed for it.' I took that side. The Baroque's accumulation would feel gorgeous on a cinema screen; on a projector at forty metres with a lyric band that must stay legible, it becomes weather rather than sanctuary.

What survives from the Baroque is the one thing that was genuinely right: the light-source asymmetry at (52%, 4%). The Baroque Dramatist understood that a centred sun is a logo. That coordinate now governs the cantus firmus grid's node-density bias, the god-ray column positions, the anamorphic flare anchor, and the filament highlight gradient direction — every downstream element answerable to the same declared point, which is exactly the Classical structural argument applied to the Baroque's best instinct. The Radical Minimalist cut the persistence ghost and restored the dimming band as a clean rectangle; asking the caustic mesh itself to perform text safety is asking the eye to do disambiguation work at the moment it should be receiving the word.

The one decision that is yours: how large the lyric word sits against the water. The direction sets Cinzel at 185 px cap-height — dominant, authoritative, readable from the back pew without effort. The alternative is 124

quotes.line: A scene that saves its best reading for a dramatic moment is a scene that cannot be trusted at minute one.
A perfectly centred sun is a logo, not a sanctuary — that single degree of asymmetry is the kind of small, consequential human decision that separates a composed scene from a generated one.
